name: pagination-dots
summary: Presentational pagination indicator: a horizontal row of small dots where the active dot **expands** into a pill that announces the current page. Mirrors the canonical [Web-ODS Shared Library → Pagination dots master](https://www.figma.com/design/0o8SL5BEk8wHtgud00dRyg/Web-ODS-Shared-Library?node-id=1278-1668&m=dev) (`1278:1668`) and the [light / dark preview composition](https://www.figma.com/design/0o8SL5BEk8wHtgud00dRyg/Web-ODS-Shared-Library?node-id=1278-1877&m=dev) (`1278:1877`). Core default theme unit; brand packages supply theme token values.

properties.name: count
properties.description: Total number of dots rendered in the row.

properties.name: current
properties.description: Position of the active expanding pill (1-indexed). Must be `>= 1` and `<= count`.

properties.name: appearance
properties.description: `light` paints inactive dots `--color-border-subtle` + active pill `--color-text-primary`; `dark` paints inactive dots `--color-text-inverse` at 40 % opacity + active pill `--color-bg-default`. Designer follow-up: publish a dedicated `--color-pagination-dot-inactive-on-dark` semantic alias so the dark-mode wash doesn't bind to a foreground-role token at runtime opacity.

properties.name: accessibleLabel
properties.description: Bound to the root `<nav>`'s `aria-label`. Tokens `{current}` and `{count}` interpolate at render time.

variants.values: `1` … `count` integer. Position of the active pill (1-indexed).
`light` (default) / `dark`. Repaints inactive vs active fills for the surface the component sits on.

accessibility: Root element is `<nav>` with `aria-label="Page {current} of {count}"` (the literal interpolated label).
Inactive dots are plain `<span>` (no interactive semantics).
WCAG: every (appearance × position) combination meets AA non-text contrast on its target surface.
